record.question: Choose the incorrect statement regarding Urgent Works:
options: Quotation for works with estimated cost up to 5 lakh shall be invited through e-tendering platform.
Availability of funds needs to be ensured before taking up execution of urgent works.
In case of Deposit works, urgent works can be taken up on written request of the client.
Details of urgent works should be compiled by each circle/zone on quarterly basis and submitted to ADG/SDG for review.
record.explanation: Urgent works are not taken through e-tendering for small quotations.
